from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashReportingPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single financial data point extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the filing")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers")
    cash_equivalent_amount: float | None = Field(description="The Cash and Cash Equivalents amount reported in dollars")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label text found in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of financial document (e.g., 10-K, 10-Q)")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_reportings: list[CashReportingPoint]
